title: Return to Sender
narration: A parcel arrived containing everything I would need to murder my husband. A note ordered me to act before nine, and a photograph proved someone had entered our bedroom. At dinner my husband reached beneath the table, so I raised the parcel's knife. He produced a wedding ring, waited until I lowered the blade, then opened a drawer filled with identical notes, photographs and rings addressed to other women. For several seconds I could hear nothing except my breathing and the small ordinary sounds around me. Every explanation I tried made the details worse, because each clue had been placed where I alone would find it. I wanted to leave immediately, but doing that would mean abandoning the only proof that any of this had happened. Our wedding picture showed six different women wearing my face, and he whispered, 'Time to try again.'
